title: Periodic walls decide every direction
claim: For every three-place tiling contact with a constant frame, an odd class has an assignment on its cylinder exactly when some periodic wall crosses that cylinder without meeting its own copies, equivalently when the torus's wall graph has a closed walk with a transverse class and no overlap in Z c + Z e (necessity through cyclic covers). For the six bending contacts whose walls move only up or left, all odd classes in the open first quadrant contradict together, exactly when the wall graph has no cycle.
failure_conditions: A configuration whose cylinder along an odd class has an assignment but no periodic wall crossing it without meeting its own copies, or the reverse.
A configuration of a directed bending contact whose first-quadrant odd classes split.
foundation_claim_scope: Twisted fair worlds on triangular tori with cylinder covers; exact statements and finite computations. Lattices are declared; no space or physics is claimed.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py (standard library, with the shared machinery of DIRECTIONAL-RIGIDITY-20261023-001B-P001) certifies 761 odd classes of 153 sampled configurations of the 27 placements with a constant frame on 3 x 3 and 3 x 4: for all 292 with an assignment it extracts from a cyclic-cover assignment a crossing wall whose closed walk passes the criterion and rebuilds an assignment from that walk alone; for all 469 contradicting it finds no simple cycle passing the criterion; the quadrant rule holds on the samples and on 363331584 frozen configuration-twists; three controls behave as stated. No human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with sampled constructive checks of both directions
